mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing levonorgestrel concentrations and contraceptive efficacy while also increasing amiodarone levels; amiodarone may prolong QT interval which could be relevant in hormonal contraceptive users.
action: Monitor for increased amiodarone adverse effects (bradycardia, QT prolongation) and counsel on breakthrough bleeding; consider alternative contraception or increased amiodarone monitoring if used concurrently.
